page.overview:
Who is Okuni?

"Okuni is a micro car Kabuki dancer who dons the traditional white-painted face and an exquisite colorful kimono for her performances at the Kabuki theater in Tokyo, Japan."

In the film, when The Team McQueen arrived to japan, She appeared with Shigeko and Tamiko at the Kabuki Za Theatre dancing, later they appeared at the Tokyo National Art Center and finally appeared at the Tokyo Imperial Palace for the Tokyo Grand Prix for the World Grand Prix.
